svg.title: Where you are headed: a square
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of an XRP robot on a plain floor carrying a marker in the hole between its wheels. It waits for the button, then drives straight 20 cm, stops, and turns 90 degrees in place, drawing a blue line as it goes. It does that four times, drawing a square, and ends back on its start mark facing the way it began. Beside it, the goal in words, a box naming each side and corner as it happens, and four check boxes that fill in as the sides are drawn.
svg.text: A marker in the hole between the
wheels draws the path as it drives.

g.text: Wait for button press, first block
now the blocks run, in order
same spot, facing the same way
